claims.statement: For p>=5 prime and even f>=2, O_s=W(F_(p^(2f)))[omega]/(omega^2-p) is the complete DVR with uniformizer omega, residue cardinal p^(2f), a finite rank-four structural map from W(F_(p^f)), compatible Frobenius period f, and a square root of every integer. claims.title: Faithful descent and exact finite-free lattice, dual, intersection and valuation transport
claims.statement: For a finite compatible inclusion R->S of DVRs, S has an R-basis beginning with 1. All R-defined submodules in a K-space extend coordinatewise, so arbitrary intersections, kernels and lattice duals commute, inclusions descend, and saturation/ranks are preserved. Integer valuations and module lengths scale by the ramification index; p-normalized valuations and lengths do not change.
assumptions: All coefficient rings in the application are DVR domains with compatible fraction-field embeddings. The source unramified ring W, its field Q, Frobenius and lattice edges stay fixed.

The formulas using normalized p-valuations concern the mixed-characteristic setting with p nonzero and nonunit; zero is treated by the usual value +infinity.
